title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: DeepSeek Harness 'Creator Mode' turns chat prompts into installable plugins
bullets.summary: DeepSeek added Creator Mode to its open-source coding harness (Nov 5), letting users turn a chat prompt into an installable plugin (per ThursdAI's roundup; not independently verified).
bullets.how: The Construct: same prompt-to-skill pattern as our skills registry; worth studying how it packages and installs plugins. PRAGMA: example of low-code agent extension for client pitches. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Cognition ships SWE-2 Flash, a fast, cheap coding model
bullets.summary: Cognition released SWE-2 Flash (Nov 5), post-trained on Inkling-Small; it scores 24.0% on Cognition's own FrontierCode 2.0 and is not open weights (self-reported).
bullets.how: The Construct: candidate cheap worker for high-volume code-edit steps once we have our own evals. PRAGMA: cost/speed tier option for client coding agents. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: OpenAI Images 2.6: Flare (fast) and Sunburst (quality) API models with SVG and GIF output
bullets.summary: OpenAI launched Images 2.6 (Nov 5) with two API image models and native SVG/GIF output in ChatGPT; OpenAI claims 50% faster than 2.5.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: native SVG output is worth testing for vector logo and sign concepts, but any output still needs our fabrication/vector gates before print. The Construct: another image backend for the logo designer pipeline. PRAGMA: no.

bullets.title: Incept5 inferd: open-source Mac inference engine for many concurrent agents
bullets.summary: Incept5 released inferd (Apache 2.0), a Mac inference engine for running many local agents concurrently; the page reports scaling from 64 to 128 concurrent agents (self-reported).
bullets.how: The Construct: could host cheap local workers on the AP-Agent Mac instead of API calls for low-risk routine steps. PRAGMA: local-inference option for privacy-sensitive clients. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Agent extension is converging on prompt-to-plugin packaging (DeepSeek Creator Mode, Anthropic skills), so the durable asset is a governed registry with evals, not any one packaging format; build that gate once and let cheap models (SWE-2 Flash, local inferd) earn workloads through it. (Caveat: all items come from the ThursdAI aggregator roundup dated Nov 5, figures self-reported; no verified Nov 6-8 Anthropic, MCP, signage/CRM/DAM or funding news found, so those are omitted.)
